result.reason: The skill explicitly supports transferring photos and notes, material that can reasonably contain personal information. It handles secret share-link decryption keys and uploads encrypted manifests preserving filenames, relative paths, modification times, and unstripped metadata.

evidence.quote:
Examples:
  bun scripts/upload.mjs --server http://localhost:8080 ./dist/archive.zip
  bun scripts/upload.mjs --server https://xdrop.example.com ./photo.jpg ./notes.txt
Require the full share link, including `#k=...`. Without the fragment key, the transfer cannot be decrypted.
